subject.title: fix(devices): recover unknown requestId approvals in password mode

question: After the non-loopback missing-scope bug is fixed, should method-level password-mode approval failures be allowed to recover by approving local pairing files on implicit loopback gateways?
rationale: Source review can verify the loopback gates, but the PR changes device-pairing authorization recovery after a gateway method rejection, so the permanent security boundary needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept bounded fallback after fix
options.body: Fix the non-loopback auth-error regression, keep fallback loopback-only, and allow an auth/CLI owner to approve the recovery contract before merge.

options.title: Require gateway-only recovery
options.body: Reject local file approval for method-level password-mode failures and require gateway, doctor, or UI recovery instead.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Hold this PR if CLI approval, doctor, Control UI, and native prompt recovery need one coordinated contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded fallback after fix
recommendation.body: Fix the non-loopback auth-error regression, keep fallback loopback-only, and allow an auth/CLI owner to approve the recovery contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged replacement-fallback contract that this PR extends.
